subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should Copilot native search auto-enable from a maintained hard-coded model list, or remain managed-search-first until Copilot exposes an authoritative hosted-search capability signal?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent, but model availability does not establish hosted-search support, and publishing the shared wrapper also commits OpenClaw to new third-party SDK and default-routing semantics.

options.title: Require capability proof
options.body: Keep managed search unless an authoritative catalog field or exact-head live diagnostics establishes hosted search for each eligible model.

options.title: Own a maintained allowlist
options.body: Approve automatic native routing with a named maintenance owner, active-and-retired model tests, and live upgrade/fallback proof.

options.title: Defer Copilot auto-routing
options.body: Retain the current managed-search behavior and revisit native routing when GitHub documents or exposes a stable capability contract.

recommendation.title: Require capability proof
recommendation.body: Keep managed search unless an authoritative catalog field or exact-head live diagnostics establishes hosted search for each eligible model.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete handled the related Copilot hosted-search product boundary and is the strongest available owner for choosing the permanent default and evidence bar.
